name: Representation Interaction Flow
ascii:
Legend: `[D]` = data structure, `(O)` = operation. Backticks mark code-level state.

                         REPRESENTATION INTERACTION FLOW

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| SELECTION AND LAYER INPUTS                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                              |
|  (O) DiagramSet selection                                                                                    |
|      src/components/DiagramSetTreePanel.tsx:DiagramSetTreePanel                                              |
|      set / diagram / `viewKind` -> `activeDiagram`; current and starred entries remain marked                |
|                                                                                                              |
|  (O) Candidate batches and starred views                                                                     |
|      src/components/DiagramLineagePanel.tsx:renderCandidateBatch/renderDiagram                                |
|      lineage, batch ranking, candidate rank, selection, and featured view                                    |
|                                                                                                              |
|  (O) DiagramComponent selection                                                                              |
|      src/components/DiagramLineagePanel.tsx:ComponentLineageSection                                          |
|      captured/generated component -> `activeComponent` -> component Representation                           |
|                                                                                                              |
|  [D] Representation layers and feedback                                                                      |
|      src/components/RepresentationLayersPanel.tsx:RepresentationLayersPanel                                   |
|      choose revision-bound `orderedLayers`; feedback targets the Evidence-bearing transition into a layer    |
+-------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
                                                        |
                                                        | chosen Diagram, component, view, and layer
                                                        v
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ACTIVE REPRESENTATION                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                              |
|  (O) DiagramView interaction surface                                                                         |
|      src/components/DiagramView.tsx:DiagramView                                                               |
|      validates `asciiRevision` against the active map; derives `gridMode` and buffered-reference state       |
|      chooses the tree or diagram index and wires the active ASCII surface                                    |
|                                                                                                              |
|  [D] Stable RepresentationIndex                                                                               |
|      src/representationIndex.ts:buildRepresentationIndex                                                     |
|      revision-scoped stable nodes/elements with Evidence links; stale maps are rejected                      |
|      structural or persisted identities support visual element <-> Evidence resolution                      |
|                                                                                                              |
|  `DiagramView` supplies the index, mappings, mode, selection handlers, and reveal callback to the grid       |
+-------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
                                                        |
                                                        v
 (O) Hover, reveal, collapse, highlight
     src/components/AsciiSelectionGrid.tsx:AsciiSelectionGrid
     every rendered control and mapped span acts through stable `elementId` values

       +-- hover mapped text ------> Evidence identity + exact source location
       +-- activate mapped text ---> reveal callback -> grounding path below
       +-- tree control -----------> collapse indexed subtree
       +-- mapped gutter ----------> toggle persistent highlight
       |
       +-- pointer drag -----------> normalized rectangle bounds
              |
              v
       (O) Rectangle selection to buffer
           src/components/DiagramView.tsx:completeSelection
           bounds intersect mappings -> mapped Evidence identities -> scoped references
           `refBuffer` state returns to the Representation as a preview highlight
              |
              v
       (O) Buffered call-graph focus
           src/ref-buffer/RefBufferTray.tsx:displayCallGraph
           keep resolved references from the active source Diagram; validate and deduplicate CodeEntities
           -> `CallGraphFocusRequest` -> focused call-graph view through the supplied callback

       +-- `gridMode = capture | edit`
              |
              v
       (O) Component capture and edit mode
           src/components/DiagramView.tsx:saveCapture/editMode
           capture: released rectangle -> component capture -> completion feedback
           edit: exclude stale mappings, disable incompatible interactions, and use the ASCII editor
           App starts or leaves the edit session

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| REQUIRED GROUNDING PATH                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                              |
|  (O) Representation -> Evidence -> Corpus                                                                     |
|      src/App.tsx:revealCodeEntity                                                                             |
|                                                                                                              |
|      Representation -- stable mapping + `sourceRangeIndex` --> Evidence -- authoritative range --> Corpus    |
|      Evidence selection loads the source snippet; Corpus renders `SourceCodeView` or `TerminalMarkdownView`  |
|      Grounding follows this order only; there is no Representation-to-Corpus bypass.                         |
|                                                                                                              |
|  (O) Reversible pane movement                                                                                 |
|      src/panes/navigation.ts:PaneNavigationApi                                                                |
|      Representation pane <--- bounded, deduplicated history; replay / clear ---> Evidence / Corpus panes     |
|      activate and focus the destination, then deliver destination-specific state after rendering            |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
